comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff said Pfizer's reconciliation was effectively a full non-GAAP income statement and questioned excluding upfront and milestone payments on collaborations from Adjusted Income.
comment_letters.company_answer: Pfizer first defended the above-threshold exclusion, then after calls with staff agreed from Q1 2022 to include acquired IPR&D (upfronts, milestones, asset acquisitions) in non-GAAP and recast prior periods, and replaced the reconciliation tables.
comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: FY2022 10-K shows Acquired IPR&D as its own line: $953M (2022), $3,469M (2021), $684M (2020); these now hit Adjusted income.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Before 2022 Pfizer's adjusted EPS (also a pay metric) excluded the largest licensing deals; the SEC forced them back in, which changes any multi-year adjusted EPS trend that crosses 2021.
comment_letters.impact_estimate: 2021 acquired IPR&D $3.47B; at ~5.7B diluted shares ~$0.6/share pre-tax that the old policy could exclude (only above-threshold deals were excluded, so true recast is smaller).
comment_letters.staff_quote: Here you include in note I adjustments to exclude the upfront and milestone payments made for collaboration agreements from Research and developments expense and net income attributable to Pfizer Inc. common shareholders.
comment_letters.reply_quote: After consulting with the Staff, we hereby undertake to change our future filings to include in our externally reported Non-GAAP financial measures expenses for (a) acquired in-process research and development costs incurred in connection with upfront and milestone payments on collaboration and in-license agreements, including premiums on equity securities and (b) asset acquisitions of acquired in-process research and development.
